name: @talkform/video
description: Talkform product demos and paid-social creative

scripts.render:demo: remotion render TalkformDemo ../web/public/videos/talkform-demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --audio-codec aac && node scripts/normalize-rendered-audio.mjs ../web/public/videos/talkform-demo.mp4
scripts.render:social: remotion render TalkformSocial ../web/public/videos/talkform-social.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --audio-codec aac && node scripts/normalize-rendered-audio.mjs ../web/public/videos/talkform-social.mp4
scripts.render:higgsfield: remotion render TalkformHiggsfield ../web/public/videos/talkform-higgsfield.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20 --audio-codec aac && node scripts/normalize-rendered-audio.mjs ../web/public/videos/talkform-higgsfield.mp4
scripts.render:all: pnpm render:demo && pnpm render:social && pnpm render:higgsfield
